image_description: A close-up shot of a green, unripe fig hanging from a tree branch. The fruit is pear-shaped with smooth, dark green skin. It is surrounded by large, lobed fig leaves with prominent veins. The lighting is bright, creating high contrast and some overexposure in the background foliage. The stem connecting the fruit to the branch is visible.
